verdict.rationale: Evidence shows general merchant-restriction and JIT funding decisioning (marqeta-docs-4, -6, -7, -21, -25) but nothing about MCC codes, enhanced merchant data, wallet/entry-mode details, partial-approval, or incremental-auth signals being present in the authorization payload. This is a fair axis for a card-issuing platform, but no evidence confirms decision-grade context of the specificity described.
